notes: The digitizer's table 1 covers only the column-heading block of the rotated well table (Remarks, Other data available, Use, ... Other numbers, Well); the well rows are its table 2. The sampled block holds no data and no location of its own, so it is recorded as a table with no water data. The page title above it reads 'Table 13.--Description of water wells in Napa Valley, Calif.--Continued'; the rules do not say whether a headings-only block should instead carry the table's data type (Groundwater) and area.
